settlement_source: CF Benchmarks Bitcoin Real-Time Index (BRTI); https://www.cfbenchmarks.com/data/indices/BRTI; terms https://assets.kalshi.com/contract_terms/BTC.pdf. Source Agency = CF Benchmarks (Kraken-owned; Kraken is a constituent).
settlement_variable: Simple average of the 60 BRTI values in the minute (60 s) prior to close time T (5 PM EDT on the listed date); bucket market 'between' floor..cap inclusive (cap = X.99): YES iff floor <= average <= cap. Revisions after Expiration ignored. Unspecified: 1-s vs 200-ms sampling, window boundary, behavior with <60 values.
timezone: Rules in US Eastern (EDT/EST label); API close_time UTC authoritative (21:00Z = 5 PM EDT). DST ends Nov 1 2026, so UTC offset of 5 PM changes for later dates; verify via close_time.
tie_handling: 'Between' inclusive on both ends of the listed pair. Unrounded averages in the gap (X.99, X+1) fall in no bucket as written; how Kalshi resolves is unknown.
rounding: unknown: unspecified by Kalshi; index published to 0.01 USD, average may carry more decimals.
trading_close_vs_settlement: close_time == T == end of the 60-s averaging window, so the entire settlement window is inside live trading. Settlement timer 60 s; API expiration_time up to 1 week later (sooner of first minute after T with data, or one week); Settlement Date no later than next day unless under review.
early_close_or_void_clauses: can_close_early=1 (no condition stated). No data at Expiration Time -> resolves NO (not void). Kalshi may at sole discretion start Market Outcome Review (Rule 6.3(c)); settlement delay Rule 7.1. Position accountability $25,000/strike/member. Source-agency employees and MNPI holders barred.
title_vs_rules_divergences: Title 'Bitcoin price range on <date>?' omits the 5 PM EDT time that rules_primary specifies
Title implies spot price at an instant; rules use 60-s trailing average of the real-time index (not Coinbase/Google spot)
'60 prices collected in the last minute before expiration' while trading continues through that minute

toxicity_flags: Averaging window (T-60s..T) lies entirely inside live trading: anyone streaming the index can compute the running 60-s average; resting orders near bucket edges are adversely selected
Settlement is a 60-s TWAP of an order-book index, not a last-trade print; exchange tickers are proxies only
No data at expiration -> NO (not void)
Kalshi Market Outcome Review and settlement delay at sole discretion
CF Benchmarks is Kraken-owned and Kraken is a constituent; methodology permits expert judgement
Narrow bucket ladder: most buckets resolve NO; can_close_early=1 unconditional
